body_aggregate.method: SHA256 of sorted body-relative path + TAB + raw-file SHA256 + LF for all 24 manuscript files; UTF-8

method.scope: One affected-material inspection round: snapshot1 to current full manuscript diff; every changed body block, same-H2 adjacent/deletion boundary, and additional whole execution or parent-dependent passages identified in coverage. No full initial table regeneration.
method.isolation: No author, notes, draft or other reviewer body was opened. Coordinator supplied an unsolicited additional-zero status; it was not used as evidence. One overly broad instruction-diff call incidentally displayed a short portion of work/discovery/results.md including historical inspection descriptions. That material was excluded from all judgments; subsequent reads were restricted to actual bodies, actual parents and named contracts.

common: unlocated inventories/unmarked gaze changes/vague impressions replacing required values
speech: neighboring action repeated in another register
scripts: interpretive label instead of performable operation

screenplay: weight lost to uniform short beat

method.record_policy: Each listed sentence unit was read and classified against applicable named failures. A dash is no clear applicable failure in this inspected unit, not a whole-work approval. No default negatives are assigned to unlisted text. Paragraph parent comparison tests wording/imagery, explanatory labels, narrator/design statements and borrowed opening/action sequence separately from fidelity.
method.exceptions: Necessary time/place/camera/sound instructions, adopted inner voice/historian, meaningful silence, motivation-setting exchanges, humor, plain short replies and inherited basic actions remain permitted. A repaired yes is renewed only for a clear named failure.
method.locators: hN is current H2 order; pN counts annotation-masked Markdown blocks including heading/navigation. sN is a punctuation locator, not a linguistic parse; spans address annotation-masked UTF-8-sig decoded text.
method.quote_policy: All evidence quotes are literal current H2 substrings. NFC plus Unicode whitespace collapse would be the only allowed normalization; no normalized fallback is used.
method.snapshot_parent_policy: Some cached treatments are annotation-free/masked projections. Their cache hashes are storage-projection fingerprints only, never first-parent raw hashes. First raw context hashes are carried from the recheck1 manifest where present. Current parent hashes are computed directly.
unverified: Unchanged out-of-scope initial no/ambiguous units are not reclassified. Prior resolutions outside coverage are carried with that limitation.
No full-work completion approval, external historical-source research, media, measured duration or recorded oral performance is claimed.
Parent scopes identify actual contextual H2s, not minimal semantic alignments. Nonquoted unchanged parent wording retains its earlier reading only where identity was verified.
method.paragraph_dash: No clear named failure in inspected paragraph and actual contextual parent. This is a recorded reading judgment, not a mechanical similarity score; required shared basic acts and complete short utterances are protected.
